_ruleNotes.COR004: Workflow/Job/Step and k8s exports are build entry points — the serializer collects them; nothing imports them.
_ruleNotes.ci-overrides: CI workflow entities are one-per-repo, not per-environment: a Job or Step name never becomes a physical cloud resource name, so COR021's collision cannot happen there. COR001 is off for ci/ because GitHub Actions steps are naturally written as inline step lists (the gitlab examples make the same call).
